title: CFG overshoot, measured on real renders
hook: Same seed, cfg 7 against cfg 14, with the numbers. Higher cfg moved the layout and raised the contrast. It did not add edge detail.

verified.claim: The cfg 7 and cfg 14 renders use one prompt, one seed, SDXL base, Euler, normal schedule and 20 steps.
The brightness, contrast, edge and difference figures are the ones stored with those renders.
On a toy with exact predictions, spread and distance from the target grow with cfg while the number of predictions stays the same.

unchecked: One seed on one model. Another seed could move the figures differently.
We quote the stored brightness, contrast and edge figures as they are. We did not re-derive how each was computed, so compare them with each other, not with figures from elsewhere.
We don't claim where a good cfg sits for any model. Check its card or template, then look.
